pages.text: Welcome to Maid Mana Source! :)$(br2)Maid Mana Source adds a new task for maids called "Mana". When a maid's task is set to "Mana", she will scan for Source Jars within her work area and charge them.

In fact, by default, besides Source Jars, any block that can store mana will be a target for the maid to charge, such as $(item)Imbuement Chamber$(), $(item)Source Relay$(), etc. You can use the $(l:maid_mana_source/3_source_list#source_list)$(item)Source List$(/l) to specify which blocks the maid can charge.
